summary: Adds two projects that show how to write to the App Logs window from C and from C++.
description: Installs two small native Android projects on the New Project screen. Each has one button that writes a series of lines to the Android log from native code, which Code on the Go shows in its App Logs window: one line at each priority, formatted values, a failed system call, and a line from a second thread. The C project uses C11 and the liblog calls directly; the C++ project uses C++17 with a type-safe stream logger and an RAII timer. Both need the NDK-Installer plugin, which provides the NDK and CMake.
